facts.fact: Sorsha 生的是女儿、养的是士兵——独女是她唯一的永生筹码，每段关系都被训练成围攻。
facts.anchor: Sorsha Lobo had given birth to a daughter, but she raised a soldier.

facts.fact: 父亲也是视力障碍者（全家藏得极好）——她的盲有遗传来源。
facts.anchor: My father had been vision impaired, but no one had known that.

facts.fact: 她怀疑母亲杀父的动机：他把缺陷遗传给了本该完美的继承人。
facts.anchor: because he'd passed his disability onto what was supposed to be her perfect heir

facts.fact: 双关宣言：不会打、看不清，但会「clean house」——这栋房子很快就没有 Blackwood 了。
facts.anchor: But I know how to clean house.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 反转绵羊比喻——她从没说过羊是谁。
facts.anchor: "I never said you were the sheep, dear."

facts.fact: 对 Mei Ling 的宣战口径：Sorsha 严重低估了自己的对手。
facts.anchor: But from where I sit... I think she has severely underestimated her opponent.

facts.fact: 一石三鸟自评：喂 ego、演怨女、挑起双女族长暗战。
facts.anchor: It was a masterstroke of political theater.

facts.fact: 不想怀孕——会把缺陷传给另一个生命，她没那么残忍。
facts.anchor: I had no desire to get pregnant.
